ranking_basis: Shared prerequisites first, then the smallest validated candidate scope, then marginal additional requirement groups. No numeric effort estimate or claim of global optimality.

sequence.change: Bring push/pop/not support to the current pipeline
prerequisites: existing PR #36 updated to current interfaces
acceptance: Concrete required PUSH_GPRv_50, POP_GPRv_58 and NOT_GPRv variants instantiate and validate in the existing STS pipeline
sequence.benefit: Removes three absent-form groups shared by all 100 candidate scopes; alone completes none.

sequence.change: Close the remaining shared scalar form gaps
acceptance: Validate IMUL_GPRv_GPRv_IMMz, IMUL_GPRv_GPRv_IMMb, SAR_GPRv_IMMb and NOP_90 on the required domains
sequence.benefit: Together with PR1 removes every absent-form group in the combined 100-family scope. Historical SAR/IMUL are different concrete forms and cannot be counted as satisfying these requirements.

sequence.change: Resolve the common AU/adaptor requirements and establish initialized decoder contracts
prerequisites: PR1 and PR2 for a complete first decoder
acceptance: Instantiate and validate all required models for the 3,260 shared sites
Establish initialized table/relocation state and stack-check contract
Prioritize actual failing case groups; common immediate CMP/AND/ADD/MOV, LEA and shifts are measured hotspots
sequence.benefit: Common prerequisites for every family; use UD2 scope as the first complete acceptance target.

sequence.change: Deliver the first precise restricted-domain decoder embedding, starting with UD2
prerequisites: source admission and dispatch-domain proof obligations
acceptance: Lift and compose the measured 3,266-site candidate envelope or a proved smaller specialization
Prove full decoded output equivalence under the declared input domain
Handle invalid/out-of-family inputs only if an explicit total-wrapper theorem is included
sequence.benefit: First end-to-end decoder result; exercises the existing STS and equivalence workflow.

acceptance: Use marginal/Marginal.csv and NewNeed.csv to select each batch
First measured batch: INT3, CLC, LEAVE, RET, PMOVMSKB; zero new form/status groups after UD2, but additional cases and composition proofs remain
Refresh applicability and per-family proofs at each batch
sequence.benefit: Grow toward all 100 without requiring the entire XED decoder upfront.

sequence.change: Close remaining top-100 AU cases, then expand to full XED
acceptance: Complete precise domains for all 100 families and their union
Full decoder additionally covers all other instruction records, invalid-input behavior, and remaining host form gaps
Prioritize immediate MOV/ADD/SUB/CMP/AND case repair by measured counts rather than adding unrelated theories
sequence.benefit: Combined 100 candidate scope is 291,329 sites; full decoder candidate scope is 480,088 sites.

parallel_option: Existing emulator bootstrap can supply some missing variants after integer-core repairs and proved handler contracts; see bootstrap-context.json. Keep FP theory work separate unless a chosen implementation introduces FP host operations.
